geography: Worldwide (Sanofi net sales line 'Admelog'; the 9M 2018 appendix splits it into Europe 5, United States 32 and Rest of World -1 EUR million)
moa: Rapid-acting human insulin analog (insulin receptor agonist)

launch_evidence.quote: Admelog (insulin lispro injection) 100 Units/mL, which was launched in the U.S. in April, generated sales of €26 million in the third quarter mainly due to access in Managed Medicaid.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2018Q3, one quarter after the April 2018 US launch: the Q3 2018 release (filed 2018-10-31) is the first to print an 'Admelog' row (Q3 26, first nine months 36). The H1 2018 amount (36 - 26 = 10) is not printed as a quarter, so 2018Q2 is not carried.
series_end_reason: The Q4 2020 release (Form 6-K filed 2021-02-05, pressreleaseq42020english.htm) is the last to print an 'Admelog' row (Q4 46, full year 188); the Q1 2021 release (filed 2021-04-28) and later releases carry no Admelog row (EDGAR full-text search for 'Admelog' in CIK 1121404 finds after 2021-02-05 only Forms 20-F and a Q2 2022 release that names it in a price programme sentence).
search_log: Sanofi quarterly results press releases: listed Sanofi (CIK 1121404) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (1,516 filings, 788 Form 6-K) and located releases with EDGAR full-text search restricted to CIK 1121404 for 'Lumizyme', 'Myozyme', 'Cablivi', 'Aldurazyme' and 'Admelog' (2011-2026); every Form 6-K HTML hit was fetched (116 documents) and parsed (bs4). One release per quarter (2011Q2-2026Q3) = the earliest-filed document with a net sales table headed 'Qn YYYY net sales' / 'Qn YYYY (€ million)'; the quarter is taken from the filing date (the Q2 2012 release prints the header 'Q2 2011 net sales' over Q2 2012 figures).

The product's row is read from the first table in the release whose header starts with the quarter column (headline net sales table; from 2016 the appendix table whose first column is the worldwide total), first figure = the quarter.
Full-year checks: 2019: 66+77+51+56=250 vs full-year 250 OK; 2020: 50+44+48+46=188 vs full-year 188 OK; 2018 (Q3-Q4 only): 26+57=83 vs full-year 93, the difference being the 10 sold in H1 2018.
